description: This file is a shell script for testing Git branch and worktree operations, including conflict scenarios, ref updates, fetch behaviors, and error states, primarily used for testing edge cases and error handling in Git workflows.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, possibly with a specific message or options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be run after the current test.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the editor configuration remains unchanged.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up the editor used for todo list editing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
